notes: On the mobile self-service page the Internet selector and its rotate button no longer sit at the bottom of the collapsed "Other options" block. Picking a WAN or rotating the PPPoE address is the most common reason to open that page, and it cost a tap on a chevron first. Both are now directly above that block, visible by default and full width; the rotate button still appears only for a PPPoE egress. Everything else is unchanged from 0.4.87, which moved the configuration database onto the persistent partition instead of copying it down from RAM every few seconds.
